policies.title: HKSAR ordinary passports: Nicaragua short-visitor visa waiver
policies.summary: Hong Kong Immigration Department’s current announcement records Nicaragua’s notification that HKSAR passport holders may visit visa-free for up to 30 days.
conditions: Applies to HKSAR passport holders for visits of up to 30 days.
Ordinary passport and short visitor travel only; admission remains subject to the destination’s border controls.
Residence, work, study, transit, special passports and third-country-document routes are excluded.

policies.title: Dominican ordinary passports: Nicaragua tourism and business visa waiver
policies.summary: The live Dominican MFA treaty register records the Nicaragua agreement as in force, and its attached reciprocal note expressly exempts Dominican valid-travel-document holders for short tourism or business travel.
conditions: The linked note limits the exemption to tourism or business, up to 90 days, renewable within its stated aggregate limit.
Ordinary valid travel document and short visitor travel only; final admission remains controlled.
Residence, work, study, transit, special passports and third-country-document routes are excluded.

policies.title: Moldovan ordinary passports: Nicaragua diplomatic-mission visa
policies.summary: Moldova MFA’s current ordinary-passport country table says Nicaragua requires a visa and assigns the issuance channel to diplomatic missions.
conditions: The cited row covers ordinary passports and identifies diplomatic missions as the visa channel, requiring issuance before travel.
No eVisa, visa-on-arrival, duration, entry count, fee or exemption is inferred.
Residence, work, study, transit, special passports and third-country-document routes are excluded.

policies.title: Venezuelan ordinary passports: Nicaragua consulted visa
policies.summary: Nicaragua’s current eAIP expressly places Venezuela in ordinary-passport Category C and requires a Directorate-General endorsement through the consulate before entry.
conditions: A Category C traveller or sponsor must request the Directorate General of Migration and Foreigners endorsement through the respective consulate before entry.
This is advance consulted-visa processing, not portal evidence, ETA, eVisa or visa on arrival.
Ordinary passport and short visitor travel only; residence, work, study, transit, special passports and third-country-document routes are excluded.

conflicts.explanation: Moldova MFA’s updated ordinary-passport row says Nicaragua requires a visa through diplomatic missions; the fallback’s visa-free value is unsupported.
Nicaragua’s current Category C row requires a consular request for Directorate-General endorsement before entry, not electronic issuance.
